title: Speaker turn confidence verification and Arabic Right-to-Left (RTL) hardening

test_cases.name: Color-coded speaker turn confidence indicator
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect SpeakerConfidenceVisualizer class and confidence bar in index.html
test_cases.expected_result: Visualizer renders confidence levels with visual bars
test_cases.evidence: SpeakerConfidenceVisualizer renders turn certainty with color-coded bar

test_cases.name: Clinician speaker confirmation and reassignment flow
test_cases.expected_result: Clinician can confirm or swap speaker roles on uncertain segments
test_cases.evidence: Speaker confirmation flow allows doctor to confirm or reassign speaker roles

test_cases.name: Comprehensive Arabic RTL CSS rules in stylesheet
test_cases.expected_result: RTL rules define margin/padding/alignment flips for components
test_cases.evidence: Complete [dir='rtl'] rules define layout mirroring for Arabic mode

test_cases.name: Mixed-direction text isolation (Arabic and English)
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect bidi/direction handling in index.html components
test_cases.expected_result: BiDi isolation ensures correct punctuation and flow in mixed text
test_cases.evidence: Mixed language direction handled via bidi isolation or direction styling

test_cases.name: Cross-browser CSS and rendering resilience
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect CSS properties for modern browser support and vendor fallbacks
test_cases.expected_result: Consistent cross-browser styling with vendor fallbacks
